message: `window` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `write` panics when `[1, 1 + 2)` is outside `buf`, and nothing proves it inside here: guard the call with `if (buf.length >= 3)`, or pass `0` and a count no larger than `buf.length`

`panic` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `panic` stops the program, and no proof removes a call to it: return a `Result` and let the caller decide
